The first anomaly is catalog-svc getting 502/503 errors from the third-party api.translate.example (#94, #98, #101). catalog-svc's circuit breaker then opens with an 87% failure rate (#104), and a half-open probe later fails again (#144), so the provider is still down. With the breaker open, catalog-svc fails fast with 503 to search-api's CatalogClient.getBatch (#107, #134). search-api passes that on to web-bff, which returns GET /search 503 (#105, #124, #128, #148).

verdict.recommendedAction: Escalate to the api.translate.example provider and check their status page. Meanwhile, make translation degrade gracefully in catalog-svc: when the breaker is open, return untranslated or cached text instead of a 503 on /products/batch. Also add a fallback in search-api so partial catalog data doesn't fail the whole /search request.
